name: pdf-card-mcp
description: Local-first MCP server and CLI for turning PDFs into source-linked HTML readers, with notes/highlights publishing and stronger optional local table detection.
long_description: PDF Card Reader lets an MCP host or terminal command turn a local PDF path into a portable HTML reader. Conversion runs locally by default, preserves source text, includes source-page previews for verification, embeds detected table, figure, and formula crops, derives safe styling from the PDF palette, and writes a standalone reader that can move across devices without a hosted service. The MCP server can also validate annotation sidecars and publish selected public notes/highlights as static annotated bundles. This full variant installs the optional local ML table detector for stronger table crops while keeping deterministic document processing on-device.

tools.name: convert_pdf_to_card_html
tools.description: Convert a local PDF path into a portable, source-linked HTML reader with embedded page previews plus detected table, figure, and formula crops.

tools.name: validate_reader_annotations
tools.description: Validate a notes/highlights annotation sidecar against a generated reader HTML file.

tools.name: publish_reader_bundle
tools.description: Publish a generated reader as a single static HTML file or directory bundle with selected public notes and highlights.
